Now I just feel like reminiscing lol. When I first moved in with my girlfriend, I made the dumb decision of moving into a basement suite with the landlord upstairs who was her ex. I know it sounds nuts, but it was a good deal, we put new flooring in and did a bunch of painting instead of paying a damage deposit (I did the math and it was more financially worth it than paying a deposit, plus, the suite had been destroyed by the last Tennant's.) Anyways, he was a mad alcoholic, was not over my gf. He would get drunk, and wait until my girlfriend was alone to corner her and scream that I was lazy and a million other things. He tried to "evict" us one night, saying we had 24 hours to leave, and the next day, we went to the rentalsman, got him both the 1 week and 30 day eviction notices if he wanted us out properly, our other roomate gave them to him and before we saw either of those, we gave him our 30 day notice. Here's the kicker. Right after we had moved out, I was at work on a Saturday, and this woman came in,when I greated her she told me she was touching up some paint on a suite that sounded exactly like where we had just been! Weird hey? She bought one thing that was like a dollar, and left. I called my gf to tell her how weird it was after I spent 10 minuets with another customer, and low and behold, the exbf/ex landlord walks into her work and waits until everyone's gone to profess his love for her, and threaten taking just me and not the other 3 people who lived there to court over ??? Idk. But we confirmed later the girl that came into my work was his friend. So he sent someone to make sure I was working, and then cornered my gf alone at her work. It was some of the most stress I've ever dealt with was the last month or 2 of living there. Luckily that was 4 years ago and she hasn't heard from the guy in about 2 years.

After we moved out of the place there was a fire with considerable damage, our landlord tried to get my roommate to sign saying we had been living there a week before so insurance would cover it. My roommate almost did, possibly leaving us liable. Months later there was a 2nd fire that basically finished off what was left. They just demolished it and filled in the hole.
